statement.ru: У пчелы пять глаз.
statement.en: A bee has five eyes.

why: Bees have two compound eyes plus three simple eyes (ocelli) on top of the head.

statement.ru: У комнатной мухи четыре крыла.
statement.en: A housefly has four wings.

why: True flies have a single pair of wings; the hind pair became tiny balancing knobs.

statement.ru: Есть муравьи, которые взрываются, защищая своё гнездо.
statement.en: There are ants that blow themselves up to defend their nest.

why: Colobopsis explodens workers rupture their body, spraying toxic goo on attackers.

statement.ru: Паук выпускает паутину изо рта.
statement.en: A spider lets out its silk from its mouth.

why: Silk comes from spinnerets on the underside of the rear of the abdomen.

statement.ru: Дождевой червь дышит кожей.
statement.en: An earthworm breathes through its skin.

why: Earthworms have no lungs; gases pass through their moist skin.

statement.ru: Улитка может вылезти из раковины и найти себе побольше.
statement.en: A snail can crawl out of its shell and find a bigger one.

why: A snail's shell is part of its body and grows with it; that is hermit crabs.

statement.ru: Японские пчёлы убивают шершня, облепив его и перегрев своим теплом.
statement.en: Japanese bees kill a hornet by covering it in a ball and overheating it.

why: Hundreds of bees ball the hornet and vibrate their muscles, raising the heat to 46 °C.

statement.ru: У блохи есть крылья.
statement.en: A flea has wings.

why: Fleas are wingless insects; they get around by jumping.

statement.ru: Есть осы, которые делают мёд.
statement.en: There are wasps that make honey.

why: The Mexican honey wasp makes and stores its own honey.

statement.ru: Стрекоза может больно ужалить человека.
statement.en: A dragonfly can give a person a painful sting.

why: Dragonflies have no sting; the idea that they sting or bite people is a misconception.

statement.ru: Есть гусеницы, которые прячутся от птиц, притворяясь птичьим помётом.
statement.en: Some caterpillars hide from birds by looking like bird droppings.

why: Giant swallowtail caterpillars are camouflaged as bird droppings.

statement.ru: Клещ — это насекомое.
statement.en: A tick is an insect.

why: Ticks are arachnids, relatives of spiders, with eight legs.

statement.ru: Навозный жук может тянуть груз в тысячу раз тяжелее себя.
statement.en: A dung beetle can pull a load a thousand times its own weight.

why: Onthophagus taurus was measured pulling 1,141 times its own body mass.

statement.ru: Тутовый шелкопряд — это червяк.
statement.en: The silkworm is a worm.

why: The silkworm is a caterpillar, the larva of the silk moth.

statement.ru: Муравьи пасут тлю и собирают её сладкие выделения.
statement.en: Ants herd aphids and collect their sweet droppings.

why: Ants tend aphids and carry their honeydew back to the nest.

statement.ru: Личинка божьей коровки похожа на маленькую божью коровку.
statement.en: A ladybird larva looks like a tiny ladybird.

why: Ladybird larvae are long, segmented, dark and spiky, nothing like the round adult.

statement.ru: Есть осы, которые узнают друг друга по лицу.
statement.en: There are wasps that recognise each other by their faces.

why: Polistes fuscatus paper wasps recognise nestmates by their facial markings.

statement.ru: Оса, ужалив, теряет жало и погибает.
statement.en: A wasp loses its sting and dies after stinging.

why: Most wasps have smooth stings and can sting again and again; the barbed sting is the honeybee's.

statement.ru: Взрослая бабочка павлиноглазка атлас вообще не ест.
statement.en: An adult atlas moth never eats at all.

why: Adult atlas moths lack working mouthparts and live on fat stored by the caterpillar.

statement.ru: Взрослая бабочка-капустница грызёт листья капусты.
statement.en: An adult cabbage white butterfly chews cabbage leaves.

why: Its caterpillar eats cabbage; the adult butterfly drinks nectar.

statement.ru: Есть палочник длиной больше полуметра.
statement.en: There is a stick insect more than half a metre long.

why: A captive-bred Phryganistria chinensis reached 64 cm.

statement.ru: Кузнечик стрекочет ртом.
statement.en: A grasshopper chirps with its mouth.

why: Grasshoppers and bush crickets chirp by rubbing legs against wings or one wing against the other, never with the mouth.

statement.ru: Бо́льшую часть жизни стрекоза проводит под водой.
statement.en: A dragonfly spends most of its life underwater.

why: Nymphs live underwater for months to five years; adults mostly live five weeks or less.

statement.ru: У бабочки два крыла.
statement.en: A butterfly has two wings.

why: Butterflies have four scale-covered wings, two pairs.

statement.ru: Насекомые дышат через дырочки в боках.
statement.en: Insects breathe through little holes in their sides.

why: Air enters through spiracles along the sides of the thorax and abdomen.

statement.ru: Комары-самцы тоже пьют кровь.
statement.en: Male mosquitoes drink blood too.

why: Males drink only sugary fluids; only females take blood.

statement.ru: Глаза улитки — на верхних рожках.
statement.en: A snail's eyes are on its upper horns.

why: The upper pair of tentacles carries the eyes.

statement.ru: Слизень — это детёныш улитки, у которого ещё не выросла раковина.
statement.en: A slug is a baby snail whose shell hasn't grown yet.

why: Slugs are adult gastropods that lost the shell in evolution.

statement.ru: Некоторые самки светлячков подманивают чужих самцов вспышками и съедают их.
statement.en: Some female fireflies lure males of other species with flashes and eat them.

why: Photuris females mimic other species' signals, then kill and eat the males.

statement.ru: Шершень — это просто крупный самец обычной осы.
statement.en: A hornet is just a big male of the common wasp.

why: Hornets are their own genus, Vespa, with queens and female workers; male hornets cannot even sting.

statement.ru: Есть бактерии, которые питаются пластиком.
statement.en: There are bacteria that feed on plastic.

why: Ideonella sakaiensis breaks down PET plastic and lives on it.

statement.ru: Большинство видов пчёл живут большими семьями.
statement.en: Most kinds of bee live in big colonies.

why: Over 90 % of bee species are solitary.

statement.ru: Есть микробы, которые живут в воде горячее 100 °C.
statement.en: Some microbes live in water hotter than 100 °C.

why: Deep-sea hyperthermophiles grow up to 122 °C under high pressure.

statement.ru: Постельные клопы умеют летать.
statement.en: Bed bugs can fly.

why: Bed bugs have only tiny pad-like wing stubs and cannot fly.

statement.ru: Хоботок комара — это пучок из шести иголок.
statement.en: A mosquito's proboscis is a bundle of six needles.

why: The labium sheaths a bundle of six piercing stylets.

statement.ru: У медицинской пиявки всего один зуб.
statement.en: A medicinal leech has just one tooth.

why: It has three saw-like jaws with about 100 teeth each.

statement.ru: Термитам переваривать дерево помогают микробы в их животе.
statement.en: Microbes in a termite's gut help it digest wood.

why: Gut bacteria and protists make the enzymes that break down cellulose.

statement.ru: Опарыши сами собой заводятся в гнилом мясе.
statement.en: Maggots appear in rotting meat all by themselves.

why: Redi showed covered meat grows no maggots; they come from flies.

statement.ru: Пчелиная матка и рабочие пчёлы выводятся из одинаковых яиц.
statement.en: A queen bee and the worker bees hatch from the same kind of eggs.

why: A female egg can become a queen or a worker; feeding decides.

statement.ru: Взрослый майский жук живёт несколько лет.
statement.en: An adult cockchafer lives for several years.

why: The grub lives 3 to 5 years underground; the adult beetle lives five to seven weeks.

statement.ru: Бабочка «мёртвая голова» ворует мёд из ульев.
statement.en: The death's-head hawkmoth steals honey from beehives.

why: It raids honeybee hives and eats the honey, masking itself with the bees' scent.

statement.ru: Каждый паук плетёт паутину-ловушку.
statement.en: Every spider spins a web to catch prey.

why: Most jumping spiders build no capture webs; they stalk and leap on prey.

statement.ru: Есть дождевой червь длиной до трёх метров.
statement.en: There is an earthworm up to three metres long.

why: Amynthas mekongianus of the Mekong reaches 3 m.
